# RouteLocation v1.2.26

## 繁體中文

- 座標輸入的鍵盤「完成」會預覽單點或建立路線草稿，不會自動模擬；鍵盤上方保留取消與關閉入口。
- 多航點輸入整合為單一「建立路線草稿」操作，保留取代／附加／取消保護與原生貼上隱私。
- 播放卡停止選單明確區分保留模擬位置與恢復真實位置，路線收藏改為獨立按鈕。
- 可固定首頁快捷播放路線，重啟後保留；最近路線也可直接指定。
- 最近位置精簡列表顯示當地目前時間與最近使用時間；路線時區可拖拉或點擊展開。
- 尚未設定 S2 偏好的使用者預設開啟 Lv.17；已儲存的偏好與顯示上限保持不變。

## English

- Keyboard Done previews a coordinate or creates a route draft without starting simulation. Close and Cancel remain reachable above the keyboard.
- Multi-waypoint input has one Create Route Draft action, preserving replace/append/cancel protection and native paste privacy.
- The player Stop menu distinguishes keeping the simulated position from restoring real location, with a separate route favorite button.
- Pin a quick playback route across app restarts, including from Recent Routes.
- Compact recent locations show current local time and last use; route time zone details expand by swipe or tap.
- Users without saved S2 preferences start with Lv.17 enabled. Existing preferences and rendering limits are preserved.

Re-sign with SideStore, AltStore, TrollStore, or a compatible tool.
